china_race_dynamics.text: When you look at AI, it’s more complicated than it seems. This isn’t something that we’re experimenting with; this is really a national security thing. China is doing AI, and we need to do the same thing. When you look at this issue in classified settings, and you see how AI is being used in propaganda, in misinformation, it’s clear that if we don’t stay the leader, we’ll have a real threat to our national security.
